notes.title: Resort and Paws DLC Update
notes.content: [p]Hooray![/p][p][/p][p]The trailer for the new free DLC for Cast Cats is out! [/p][p][/p][p]We also updated the screenshots on the Steam page, so get ready for your vacation with these fluffy kittens![/p][p][/p][p]Released this August![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/J7zMDM1Qdtk"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Add to your wishlist so you don't miss out:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457020"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay fluffy and fabulous,[/p][p]The Cast Cats Team[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is out now.

A few bugs were fixed:
[list]
[*] Fix Barmaid image.
[*] Updated blur effect.
[*] The game locked at 60 FPS as default.
[/list]

Additional changes:
[list]
[*] Use keys "[" and "]" to change max FPS in a game from 10 to 120.
[/list]
